cond_0001.intro: The Compliance Analyst works to ensure the team is aligned with all legal and regulatory requirements, supporting the team on various projects and initiatives.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Conduct pre-trade, post-trade and end of day batch investment compliance monitoring activities for an assigned group of client accounts. Act as back-up analyst for other designated accounts as needed. Investigate and resolve all post-trade and end of day batch alerts for assigned accounts, with timely analysis and appropriate advancement. Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly compliance reports and certifications for assigned accounts – both internal and client facing. Perform and review various data management activities critical to the effective functioning of the compliance monitoring system. Assist in analysis of derivative and sophisticated security positions. Assist in completing information requests for clients, internal and external audit, management committees, and other functions. Contribute to the construction of internal procedures and controls, draft desk-top procedures. Perform periodic and forensic testing (for example, allocation reviews). Participate in new account onboarding and ongoing updates related to client accounts. Perform detailed analysis of assigned client account offering documents (i.e., Investment Management Agreements, IPS, Prospectus/SAI, etc), and work with internal partners (Product, Relationship Management, Trading) to acquire clarification where needed. Provide recommendations for coding client guidelines into the Compliance System (Bloomberg). Conduct reviews of new and existing rules, both systemic and manual. Assist in the development of portfolio compliance surveillance for guideline monitoring outside of the automated compliance system.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
0–3 Years proven track record as a Compliance Analyst, Fund Accountant, Fund Administrator, Risk Analyst or Security Operations Analyst
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, Law, Mathematics or equivalent work experience
Excellent analytical and research skills
Accuracy and high attention to detail
Strong written and oral communication skills
Ability to work in a time sensitive, team-oriented environment
Good organizational skills
Understanding of financial instruments data across all asset classes
Proven understanding of Microsoft Office Suite, Excel, Word and Access
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge and experience with automated daily pre-trade/post-trade compliance monitoring systems (i.e., Bloomberg, Charles River, Sentinel/Latent Zero, etc.)
Knowledge of the investment adviser and/or mutual fund industry (i.e., compliance monitoring, fund accounting/administration, risk management, security operations, etc.)
Prior experience in Investment Compliance Monitoring (especially pre-trade monitoring)

Investigate and resolve all post-trade and end of day batch alerts for assigned accounts, with timely analysis and appropriate advancement. Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly compliance reports and certifications for assigned accounts – both internal and client facing. Perform and review various data management activities critical to the effective functioning of the compliance monitoring system. Assist in analysis of derivative and sophisticated security positions. cond_0085.responsibilities: Conduct pre-trade, post-trade and end of day batch investment compliance monitoring activities for an assigned group of client accounts. Act as back-up analyst for other designated accounts as needed. Investigate and resolve all post-trade and end of day batch alerts for assigned accounts, with timely analysis and appropriate advancement. Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly compliance reports and certifications for assigned accounts – both internal and client facing. Perform and review various data management activities critical to the effective functioning of the compliance monitoring system. Assist in analysis of derivative and sophisticated security positions. Assist in completing information requests for clients, internal and external audit, management committees, and other functions. Contribute to the construction of internal procedures and controls, draft desk-top procedures. Perform periodic and forensic testing (for example, allocation reviews). Participate in new account onboarding and ongoing updates related to client accounts. Perform detailed analysis of assigned client account offering documents (i.e., Investment Management Agreements, IPS, Prospectus/SAI, etc), and work with internal partners (Product, Relationship Management, Trading) to acquire clarification where needed. Provide recommendations for coding client guidelines into the Compliance System (Bloomberg). Conduct reviews of new and existing rules, both systemic and manual. Assist in the development of portfolio compliance surveillance for guideline monitoring outside of the automated compliance system.
cond_0085.requirements:
We are seeking an individual with 0–3 years proven track record as a Compliance Analyst, Fund Accountant, Fund Administrator, Risk Analyst or Security Operations Analyst. With a Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, Law, Mathematics or equivalent work experience.
Excellent analytical and research skills
Ability to work in a time sensitive, team-oriented environment
Accuracy and high attention to detail
Strong written and oral communication skills
Good organizational skills
Understanding of financial instruments data across all asset classes
Proven understanding of Microsoft Office Suite, Excel, Word and Access
Having knowledge and experience with automated daily pre-trade/post-trade compliance monitoring systems (i.e., Bloomberg, Charles River, Sentinel/Latent Zero, etc.) is an asset.
Knowledge of the investment adviser and/or mutual fund industry (i.e., compliance monitoring, fund accounting/administration, risk management, security operations, etc.)
Prior experience in Investment Compliance Monitoring (especially pre-trade monitoring) will be an added bonus.

cond_0120.intro: The Compliance Analyst works to ensure the team is aligned with all legal and regulatory requirements, supporting the team on various projects and initiatives.
cond_0120.responsibilities: Conduct pre-trade, post-trade and end of day batch investment compliance monitoring activities for an assigned group of client accounts. Act as back-up analyst for other designated accounts as needed. Investigate and resolve all post-trade and end of day batch alerts for assigned accounts, with timely analysis and appropriate advancement. Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly compliance reports and certifications for assigned accounts – both internal and client facing. Perform and review various data management activities critical to the effective functioning of the compliance monitoring system. Assist in analysis of derivative and sophisticated security positions. Assist in completing information requests for clients, internal and external audit, management committees, and other functions. Contribute to the construction of internal procedures and controls, draft desk-top procedures. Perform periodic and forensic testing (for example, allocation reviews). Participate in new account onboarding and ongoing updates related to client accounts. Perform detailed analysis of assigned client account offering documents (i.e., Investment Management Agreements, IPS, Prospectus/SAI, etc), and work with internal partners (Product, Relationship Management, Trading) to acquire clarification where needed. Provide recommendations for coding client guidelines into the Compliance System (Bloomberg). Conduct reviews of new and existing rules, both systemic and manual. Assist in the development of portfolio compliance surveillance for guideline monitoring outside of the automated compliance system.

Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally

cond_0222.responsibilities: Conduct pre-trade, post-trade and end of day batch investment compliance monitoring activities for an assigned group of client accounts. Stay in contact with other analysts and act as back-up for designated accounts as needed. Investigate and resolve all post-trade and end of day batch alerts for assigned accounts, with timely analysis and appropriate advancement. Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly compliance reports and certifications for assigned accounts – both internal and client facing. Perform and review various data management activities critical to the effective functioning of the compliance monitoring system. Assist in analysis of derivative and sophisticated security positions. Assist in completing information requests for clients, internal and external audit, management committees, and other functions, often communicating directly with those groups to clarify needs. Contribute to the construction of internal procedures and controls, draft desk-top procedures. Perform periodic and forensic testing (for example, allocation reviews). Participate in new account onboarding and ongoing updates related to client accounts. Perform detailed analysis of assigned client account offering documents (i.e., Investment Management Agreements, IPS, Prospectus/SAI, etc), and actively connect with internal partners (Product, Relationship Management, Trading) to acquire clarification where needed. Provide recommendations for coding client guidelines into the Compliance System (Bloomberg). Conduct reviews of new and existing rules, both systemic and manual. Assist in the development of portfolio compliance surveillance for guideline monitoring outside of the automated compliance system.
cond_0222.requirements:
We are seeking an individual with 0–3 years proven track record as a Compliance Analyst, Fund Accountant, Fund Administrator, Risk Analyst or Security Operations Analyst. With a Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, Law, Mathematics or equivalent work experience.
Minimum Requirements
Excellent analytical and research skills
Accuracy and high attention to detail
Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to explain findings clearly and handle questions from clients and internal teams
Ability to work in a time sensitive, team-oriented environment
Good organizational skills
Understanding of financial instruments data across all asset classes
Proven understanding of Microsoft Office Suite, Excel, Word and Access
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge and experience with automated daily pre-trade/post-trade compliance monitoring systems (i.e., Bloomberg, Charles River, Sentinel/Latent Zero, etc.)
Knowledge of the investment adviser and/or mutual fund industry (i.e., compliance monitoring, fund accounting/administration, risk management, security operations, etc.)
Prior experience in Investment Compliance Monitoring (especially pre-trade monitoring)
cond_0222.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0222.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.

cond_0284.intro: The Compliance Analyst works to ensure the team is aligned with all legal and regulatory requirements, supporting the team on various projects and initiatives. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with compliance monitoring and investment guidelines.
cond_0284.responsibilities: Conduct pre-trade, post-trade and end of day batch investment compliance monitoring activities for an assigned group of client accounts. Act as back-up analyst for other designated accounts as needed. Investigate and resolve all post-trade and end of day batch alerts for assigned accounts, with timely analysis and appropriate advancement. Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly compliance reports and certifications for assigned accounts – both internal and client facing. Perform and review various data management activities critical to the effective functioning of the compliance monitoring system. Assist in analysis of derivative and sophisticated security positions. Assist in completing information requests for clients, internal and external audit, management committees, and other functions. Contribute to the construction of internal procedures and controls, draft desk-top procedures. Perform periodic and forensic testing (for example, allocation reviews). Participate in new account onboarding and ongoing updates related to client accounts. Perform detailed analysis of assigned client account offering documents (i.e., Investment Management Agreements, IPS, Prospectus/SAI, etc), and work with internal partners (Product, Relationship Management, Trading) to acquire clarification where needed. Provide recommendations for coding client guidelines into the Compliance System (Bloomberg). Conduct reviews of new and existing rules, both systemic and manual. Assist in the development of portfolio compliance surveillance for guideline monitoring outside of the automated compliance system.

cond_0318.responsibilities: Conduct pre-trade, post-trade and end of day batch investment compliance monitoring activities for an assigned group of client accounts. Act as back-up analyst for other designated accounts as needed. Investigate and resolve all post-trade and end of day batch alerts for assigned accounts, with timely analysis and appropriate advancement. Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly compliance reports and certifications for assigned accounts – both internal and client facing. Perform and review various data management activities critical to the effective functioning of the compliance monitoring system. Assist in analysis of derivative and sophisticated security positions. Assist in completing information requests for clients, internal and external audit, management committees, and other functions. Contribute to the construction of internal procedures and controls, draft desk-top procedures. Perform periodic and forensic testing (for example, allocation reviews). Participate in new account onboarding and ongoing updates related to client accounts. Perform detailed analysis of assigned client account offering documents (i.e., Investment Management Agreements, IPS, Prospectus/SAI, etc), and work with internal partners (Product, Relationship Management, Trading) to acquire clarification where needed. Provide recommendations for coding client guidelines into the Compliance System (Bloomberg). Conduct reviews of new and existing rules, both systemic and manual. Assist in the development of portfolio compliance surveillance for guideline monitoring outside of the automated compliance system.
cond_0318.requirements:
We are seeking an individual with around 0–3 years of experience as a Compliance Analyst, Fund Accountant, Fund Administrator, Risk Analyst or Security Operations Analyst, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. A Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, Law, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Some analytical and research ability, with a willingness to develop these skills further
Ability to work in a time sensitive, team-oriented environment
Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally
Good organizational skills
Some background in financial instruments data across asset classes
Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word and Access
Exposure to automated daily pre-trade/post-trade compliance monitoring systems (i.e., Bloomberg, Charles River, Sentinel/Latent Zero, etc.) is an asset
Some knowledge of the investment adviser and/or mutual fund industry (i.e., compliance monitoring, fund accounting/administration, risk management, security operations, etc.)
Any experience with Investment Compliance Monitoring (especially pre-trade monitoring) is a bonus but not required

cond_0384.intro: The Compliance Analyst works to ensure the team is aligned with all legal and regulatory requirements, supporting the team on various projects and initiatives. A large part of the role involves regular communication with internal partners, clients, and other functions to keep compliance activities on track.
cond_0384.responsibilities: Conduct pre-trade, post-trade and end of day batch investment compliance monitoring activities for an assigned group of client accounts. Stay in contact with other analysts and act as back-up for designated accounts as needed. Investigate and resolve all post-trade and end of day batch alerts for assigned accounts, with timely analysis and appropriate advancement. Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly compliance reports and certifications for assigned accounts – both internal and client facing. Perform and review various data management activities critical to the effective functioning of the compliance monitoring system. Assist in analysis of derivative and sophisticated security positions. Assist in completing information requests for clients, internal and external audit, management committees, and other functions, often communicating directly with those groups to clarify needs. Contribute to the construction of internal procedures and controls, draft desk-top procedures. Perform periodic and forensic testing (for example, allocation reviews). Participate in new account onboarding and ongoing updates related to client accounts. Perform detailed analysis of assigned client account offering documents (i.e., Investment Management Agreements, IPS, Prospectus/SAI, etc), and actively connect with internal partners (Product, Relationship Management, Trading) to acquire clarification where needed. Provide recommendations for coding client guidelines into the Compliance System (Bloomberg). Conduct reviews of new and existing rules, both systemic and manual. Assist in the development of portfolio compliance surveillance for guideline monitoring outside of the automated compliance system.
cond_0384.requirements:
We are seeking an individual with 0–3 years proven track record as a Compliance Analyst, Fund Accountant, Fund Administrator, Risk Analyst or Security Operations Analyst. With a Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, Law, Mathematics or equivalent work experience.
Minimum Requirements
Excellent analytical and research skills
Accuracy and high attention to detail
Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to explain findings clearly and handle questions from clients and internal teams
Ability to work in a time sensitive, team-oriented environment
Good organizational skills
Understanding of financial instruments data across all asset classes
Proven understanding of Microsoft Office Suite, Excel, Word and Access

Knowledge and experience with automated daily pre-trade/post-trade compliance monitoring systems (i.e., Bloomberg, Charles River, Sentinel/Latent Zero, etc.)
Knowledge of the investment adviser and/or mutual fund industry (i.e., compliance monitoring, fund accounting/administration, risk management, security operations, etc.)
Prior experience in Investment Compliance Monitoring (especially pre-trade monitoring)

cond_0395.intro: The Compliance Analyst takes ownership of ensuring the team stays aligned with all legal and regulatory requirements, leading various projects and initiatives.
cond_0395.responsibilities: Conduct pre-trade, post-trade and end of day batch investment compliance monitoring activities for an assigned group of client accounts. Act as back-up analyst for other designated accounts as needed. Investigate and resolve all post-trade and end of day batch alerts for assigned accounts, with timely analysis and appropriate advancement. Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly compliance reports and certifications for assigned accounts – both internal and client facing. Execute and oversee various data management activities critical to the effective functioning of the compliance monitoring system. Lead analysis of derivative and sophisticated security positions. Take ownership of completing information requests for clients, internal and external audit, management committees, and other functions. Drive the construction of internal procedures and controls, draft desk-top procedures. Perform periodic and forensic testing (for example, allocation reviews). Direct new account onboarding and ongoing updates related to client accounts. Perform detailed analysis of assigned client account offering documents (i.e., Investment Management Agreements, IPS, Prospectus/SAI, etc), and engage internal partners (Product, Relationship Management, Trading) to acquire clarification where needed. Deliver recommendations for coding client guidelines into the Compliance System (Bloomberg). Conduct reviews of new and existing rules, both systemic and manual. Lead the development of portfolio compliance surveillance for guideline monitoring outside of the automated compliance system.

cond_0419.responsibilities: Conduct pre-trade, post-trade and end of day batch investment compliance monitoring activities for an assigned group of client accounts. Act as back-up analyst for other designated accounts as needed. Investigate and resolve all post-trade and end of day batch alerts for assigned accounts, with timely analysis and appropriate advancement. Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly compliance reports and certifications for assigned accounts – both internal and client facing. Perform and review various data management activities critical to the effective functioning of the compliance monitoring system. Assist in analysis of derivative and sophisticated security positions. Assist in completing information requests for clients, internal and external audit, management committees, and other functions. Contribute to the construction of internal procedures and controls, draft desk-top procedures. Perform periodic and forensic testing (for example, allocation reviews). Participate in new account onboarding and ongoing updates related to client accounts. Perform detailed analysis of assigned client account offering documents (i.e., Investment Management Agreements, IPS, Prospectus/SAI, etc), and work with internal partners (Product, Relationship Management, Trading) to acquire clarification where needed. Provide recommendations for coding client guidelines into the Compliance System (Bloomberg). Conduct reviews of new and existing rules, both systemic and manual. Assist in the development of portfolio compliance surveillance for guideline monitoring outside of the automated compliance system.
cond_0419.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Excellent analytical and research skills
Accuracy and high attention to detail
Strong written and oral communication skills
Good organizational skills
Ability to work in a time sensitive, team-oriented environment
Understanding of financial instruments data across all asset classes
Proven understanding of Microsoft Office Suite, Excel, Word and Access
0–3 Years proven track record as a Compliance Analyst, Fund Accountant, Fund Administrator, Risk Analyst or Security Operations Analyst
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, Law, Mathematics or equivalent work experience
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge and experience with automated daily pre-trade/post-trade compliance monitoring systems (i.e., Bloomberg, Charles River, Sentinel/Latent Zero, etc.)
Knowledge of the investment adviser and/or mutual fund industry (i.e., compliance monitoring, fund accounting/administration, risk management, security operations, etc.)
Prior experience in Investment Compliance Monitoring (especially pre-trade monitoring)
cond_0419.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.

cond_0454.intro: The Compliance Analyst works to ensure the team is aligned with all legal and regulatory requirements, supporting the team on various projects and initiatives. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp how investment guidelines translate into compliance rules and monitoring logic.
cond_0454.responsibilities: Conduct pre-trade, post-trade and end of day batch investment compliance monitoring activities for an assigned group of client accounts. Act as back-up analyst for other designated accounts as needed. Investigate and resolve all post-trade and end of day batch alerts for assigned accounts, with timely analysis and appropriate advancement. Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly compliance reports and certifications for assigned accounts – both internal and client facing. Perform and review various data management activities critical to the effective functioning of the compliance monitoring system. Assist in analysis of derivative and sophisticated security positions. Assist in completing information requests for clients, internal and external audit, management committees, and other functions. Contribute to the construction of internal procedures and controls, draft desk-top procedures. Perform periodic and forensic testing (for example, allocation reviews). Participate in new account onboarding and ongoing updates related to client accounts. Perform detailed analysis of assigned client account offering documents (i.e., Investment Management Agreements, IPS, Prospectus/SAI, etc), and work with internal partners (Product, Relationship Management, Trading) to acquire clarification where needed. Provide recommendations for coding client guidelines into the Compliance System (Bloomberg). Conduct reviews of new and existing rules, both systemic and manual. Assist in the development of portfolio compliance surveillance for guideline monitoring outside of the automated compliance system.

cond_0486.intro: The Compliance Analyst works alongside the team to help ensure alignment with all legal and regulatory requirements, supporting colleagues across various projects and initiatives.
cond_0486.responsibilities: Coordinate pre-trade, post-trade, and end of day batch investment compliance monitoring activities for an assigned group of client accounts. Support other analysts as back-up for designated accounts as needed. Work through post-trade and end of day batch alerts for assigned accounts, sharing timely analysis and escalating where appropriate. Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly compliance reports and certifications for assigned accounts – both internal and client facing. Collaborate on various data management activities critical to the effective functioning of the compliance monitoring system. Assist in the analysis of derivative and sophisticated security positions. Help complete information requests for clients, internal and external audit, management committees, and other functions. Contribute to the construction of internal procedures and controls, and help draft desk-top procedures. Participate in periodic and forensic testing (for example, allocation reviews). Take part in new account onboarding and ongoing updates related to client accounts. Work with internal partners (Product, Relationship Management, Trading) to review assigned client account offering documents (i.e., Investment Management Agreements, IPS, Prospectus/SAI, etc.) and clarify requirements where needed. Share recommendations for coding client guidelines into the Compliance System (Bloomberg). Coordinate reviews of new and existing rules, both systemic and manual. Support the development of portfolio compliance surveillance for guideline monitoring outside of the automated compliance system.

cond_0508.intro: The Compliance Analyst works to ensure the team is aligned with all legal and regulatory requirements, supporting the team on various projects and initiatives. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp how investment guidelines translate into compliance rules and monitoring logic.
cond_0508.responsibilities: Conduct pre-trade, post-trade and end of day batch investment compliance monitoring activities for an assigned group of client accounts. Act as back-up analyst for other designated accounts as needed. Investigate and resolve all post-trade and end of day batch alerts for assigned accounts, with timely analysis and appropriate advancement. Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly compliance reports and certifications for assigned accounts – both internal and client facing. Perform and review various data management activities critical to the effective functioning of the compliance monitoring system. Assist in analysis of derivative and sophisticated security positions. Assist in completing information requests for clients, internal and external audit, management committees, and other functions. Contribute to the construction of internal procedures and controls, draft desk-top procedures. Perform periodic and forensic testing (for example, allocation reviews). Participate in new account onboarding and ongoing updates related to client accounts. Perform detailed analysis of assigned client account offering documents (i.e., Investment Management Agreements, IPS, Prospectus/SAI, etc), and work with internal partners (Product, Relationship Management, Trading) to acquire clarification where needed. Provide recommendations for coding client guidelines into the Compliance System (Bloomberg). Conduct reviews of new and existing rules, both systemic and manual. Assist in the development of portfolio compliance surveillance for guideline monitoring outside of the automated compliance system.
cond_0508.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Excellent analytical and research skills
Accuracy and high attention to detail
Strong written and oral communication skills
Good organizational skills
Ability to work in a time sensitive, team-oriented environment
Understanding of financial instruments data across all asset classes
Proven understanding of Microsoft Office Suite, Excel, Word and Access
0–3 Years proven track record as a Compliance Analyst, Fund Accountant, Fund Administrator, Risk Analyst or Security Operations Analyst
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, Law, Mathematics or equivalent work experience
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge and experience with automated daily pre-trade/post-trade compliance monitoring systems (i.e., Bloomberg, Charles River, Sentinel/Latent Zero, etc.)
Knowledge of the investment adviser and/or mutual fund industry (i.e., compliance monitoring, fund accounting/administration, risk management, security operations, etc.)
Prior experience in Investment Compliance Monitoring (especially pre-trade monitoring)
